name: org-formation
description: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool for AWS Organizations

readme.summary: Excellent documentation with clear feature explanations, comprehensive examples, and good installation instructions, though configuration details and troubleshooting could be more comprehensive.
readme.top_issue: Configuration documentation is scattered across linked files rather than consolidated, and troubleshooting section only covers performance issues without addressing common errors or setup problems.

injection_risks.description: Potential command injection vulnerability in performInit, performCreateOrUpdate and performRemove methods due to the use of user-controlled input (customInitCommand, customDeployCommand, customRemoveCommand) in shell commands.
Potential command injection vulnerability in performCreateOrUpdate and performRemove methods due to the use of user-controlled input (parameters) in shell commands.
Potential command injection vulnerability in performCreateOrUpdate and performRemove methods due to the use of user-controlled input (backendConfig) in shell commands.

critical_findings: Potential command injection vulnerabilities in performInit, performCreateOrUpdate and performRemove methods.
Lack of input validation for customInitCommand, customDeployCommand, customRemoveCommand, parameters and backendConfig inputs.
security.summary: The code has potential security risks due to command injection vulnerabilities and lack of input validation, but it does not expose sensitive information or use insecure defaults.

common_complaints: Concurrency issues with CDK deployments causing file locks
AWS service deprecation (CodeCommit) not addressed in documentation
Race conditions and timing issues with new account creation
Template syntax inconsistencies across different CLI commands
sentiment.summary: Moderate community health with technical debt issues around AWS API limitations and concurrency bugs, but recent issue closure and label management indicate active maintenance.

communication.summary: Maintainer responses are clear, helpful, and demonstrate patience with users of varying skill levels.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite last commit being recent (2026-01-19)
95 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months indicates no active issue triage
Zero active contributors in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months suggests no pull request review/integration
Unknown last release date suggests no recent releases
maintenance.summary: org-formation shows signs of abandonment with no maintenance activity (commits, PR merges, or issue resolution) in the past 6 months despite a recent commit timestamp.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-structured and clear, with breaking changes marked but lacks migration guides.

governance.summary: The project lacks a succession plan and contributor ladder, which increases the risk of bus factor.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The documentation is generally well-structured and informative, but could benefit from more concise language and additional troubleshooting resources.
